title: Clear Release Gate Dependabot alerts and Security Gates secret-scan false positives
goal: main's Release Gate is blocked by 5 open high/critical Dependabot alerts (4x google.golang.org/grpc including CVE-2026-33186 critical; 1x go-jose/v3 CVE-2026-34986 high), with Candidate Checks additionally failing on SonarCloud new_security_rating=3 caused by kubernetes:S6865 (automounted service account) in the newly added k8s/backend/deployment.yaml. Security Gates is separately blocked by two gitleaks curl-auth-header false positives on documentation placeholders (Bearer YOUR_TOKEN) introduced by the v0.12.0 squash commit b2e90791 whose fingerprints differ from the already-ignored 178756d ones. Upgrade the vulnerable dependencies, disable service-account token automounting, and append the missing fingerprints so both gates return to green.

in: backend/go.mod + go.sum: grpc 1.76.0 -> 1.83.1, go-jose/v3 3.0.1 -> 3.0.5, otlptracehttp 1.24.0 -> 1.43.0 (with transitive bumps)
.gitleaksignore: two fingerprints for commit b2e90791 documentation placeholder findings
out: any application code change (dependency upgrade only)
